name: forge-gate
description: Enforces the forge phase gate: shows whether the current phase's Verifiable gate is green on exactly the files you have, and sends back a forge stage whose FORGE_RESULT claims "gate":"green" when it isn't. /gate runs it.

guardDoneClaims.title: Guard green claims
guardDoneClaims.description: Send a forge stage back when its FORGE_RESULT claims "gate":"green", or Claude says the phase is done, while the gate is not green on the current files. Off turns both guards off.
